server_scripts.name: Orchestrator Agent: Read the Work Item
server_scripts.script:
# Orchestrator Agent — Read the Work Item.
# This map runs as a SUB-PROCESS of Software Development, so the instance context
# is already the Work Item that was flagged for the orchestrator — there is no A2A
# Task to lift a brief off. Build the brief out of the same fields a person would
# have read before starting work.
title = (doc.title or "").strip()
body = frappe.utils.strip_html(doc.description or "").strip()

brief = title
if body:
    brief = title + "\n\n" + body

result["work_item"] = doc.name
result["work_item_brief"] = brief

server_scripts.name: Orchestrator Agent: Record the Outcome
server_scripts.script:
# Orchestrator Agent — Record the Outcome. # There is no A2A Task to answer here: the caller is the Software Development # instance this map runs inside, so the report goes back as workflow data and is # written onto the Work Item as a comment so the trail outlives the instance. # # Nothing here sets a Work Item FIELD. Status is the Software Development process's # business — the orchestrator reporting its own outcome into `status` would race the # very steps that called it. report = (task_data.get("ai_result") or "").strip() if not report: report = "The orchestrator produced no report." # `connector_result` is the delegate shape's resultVariable. It is absent when the # orchestrator decided no specialist applied, which is a real outcome, not an error. delegated = task_data.get("connector_result") result["orchestrator_report"] = report result["orchestrator_delegated_to"] = "Connector Agent" if delegated else None doc.add_comment("Comment", "Orchestrator
" + frappe.utils.escape_html(report))
